name: Justinian
biography: Emperor from 527 to 565, chiefly noted for his Digest of Roman law, his closing of the pagan philosophical schools at Athens in 529, his building of St. Sophia, and his costly, only partially successful attempt to reconquer Italy and Africa from the Goths and Vandals.
